# MediaPipe Hand Landmarker

The Vision Tasks JavaScript and WASM files are from
[`@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.21`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.21).
The [Hand Landmarker model](https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task)
is the Float16 revision 1 listed in the [Google AI Edge documentation](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker).
The accompanying Apache 2.0 license is included here.
